decision.message: The esp32_bmp280_v1 family with the low_current profile at 100 kHz and 10k pull-ups, supporting 100 pF total bus capacitance, meets all requirements. Default supply voltage and ambient operating limits are applied. This configuration reduces only the I2C pull-up current as requested, without reducing whole-board power or battery optimization.
